items.details: Recommended by Nataly 'for the ultimate escape into an untouched environment that stands in complete contrast to buzzing Taipei'; article spells it 'Toroko', commonly Taroko
items.name: Toroko National Park

items.details: Described as one of their favourite temples, decorated by a huge statue of Buddha at its entrance
items.name: Fo Guang temple

items.details: Murad: 'we were quickly enchanted by the mountains and forests of the Alishan region, which truly looks like some sort of fairy-tale'
items.name: Alishan region

items.details: Murad advises paying a visit to the emerald tea plantations 'which I'm sure would rival even the finest of those in India and Sri Lanka'; tea houses host traditional tea ceremonies; they especially liked the ulun variety, fragrant and subtle with a slightly spicy taste
items.name: Emerald tea plantations and tea houses

itineraries.summary: Interview feature in which Nataly and Murad Osmann share their favorite spots from their Taiwan trip (a fashion shoot and FollowMeTo exhibition visit): temples, Taroko National Park, the Alishan region's mountains and forests, and emerald tea plantations with traditional tea ceremonies.
itineraries.title: Taiwan travel recommendations (Nataly & Murad Osmann)

itineraries.summary: In a Travel + Leisure India interview, Murad Osmann describes his bespoke #FollowMeToTour travel club ('where we take a group with us on our travels') and its Egypt trip, for which they arranged private access to the pyramids and the Sphinx plus a night tour of an Egyptian museum. No day-by-day structure, hotels, or prices were given.
itineraries.title: Egypt group trip via #FollowMeToTour travel club

notes: Murad Osmann is a luxury travel photographer whose #FollowMeTo output is overwhelmingly single-signature photos (hand-holding pose), not itineraries; no day-by-day guides or 'N days in X' posts by him exist anywhere found. The two entries above are the most itinerary-like extractable facts: (1) a recommendation list tied to his Taiwan trip (medium confidence - sourced from an interview feature quoting both Osmanns), and (2) fragmentary highlights of an actual group trip run through his #FollowMeToTour travel club (low confidence - no structure, hotels, dates, or prices given). His YouTube 'Follow Me To: The Philippines' series episodes are vlog episode outlines, not traveler-followable itineraries, and were not included. No hotels, restaurants, prices, day counts, or booking links appeared in any source, so those fields are null throughout.
